CachingDemo.title: Rendering & Caching (Cache Components)
CachingDemo.intro: Same page, two data sources: one cached into the static shell, one rendered per request and streamed in.
CachingDemo.cachedHint: Generated at build/revalidate time — stable across reloads (cacheLife 'hours' + cacheTag).
CachingDemo.liveHint: Generated on every request via connection() — changes each reload; streamed inside Suspense.
CachingDemo.revalidateHint: Calls POST /api/revalidate → revalidateTag → the cached timestamp updates.
